messages.content: generate a binary tree and a heap sort and tell me their diffrences

**Binary Tree vs Heap (data structure) vs Heapsort (algorithm):**
Binary Tree (general)HeapHeapsort
Any tree where each node has ≤2 childrenA nearly complete binary tree stored in an array with the heap propertyA sorting algorithm that uses a max-heap
No ordering constraint between parent/child valuesMax-heap: parent ≥ children; Min-heap: parent ≤ childrenBuilds a max-heap from the array, then repeatedly extracts the root
Stored via pointers (nodes with left/right references)Stored implicitly in an array using index arithmetic: PARENT(i)=i/2, LEFT(i)=2i, RIGHT(i)=2i+1In-place, O(n lg n) worst-case, not stable
**Key difference:** A heap is a *specific kind* of binary tree (complete + heap property). Heapsort is the *algorithm* that exploits that structure to sort in O(n lg n) time with O(1) extra space.
